chapters.title: Why adoption fails: never the technology
Planning, migration choices and landing zones
The sequencing mistake and the M365 version
Measuring structural adoption vs. feature usage

takeaways: Microsoft 365 and Copilot rollouts rarely fail because of the tools; they fail because nobody designs for behavior change and the assumption that structure alone changes behavior goes unchallenged.
Govern the platform as one system before rollout: identity, admin roles, default sharing, retention, MFA and conditional access, with named owners and clear accountability.
Measure adoption with three layers together, structural, usage and business outcomes, because rising usage with flat outcomes is a warning sign, not a win.
hook: Your Microsoft 365 or Copilot rollout looks great on the license report, yet nothing about how people work has changed. This episode is for IT leaders and adoption owners who follow the Cloud Adoption Framework and M365 adoption guide but still stall, and shows why governance-first sequencing, named accountability and a three-layer scorecard decide real success.
